description: This file defines a MobileNetBackbone class and a function to construct a RetinaNet model with a MobileNet backbone, including methods for downloading pre-trained weights, validation, and image preprocessing.

classes.name: MobileNetBackbone
classes.description: Class representing a MobileNet backbone for object detection models, providing utility functions such as weight download, validation, and image preprocessing.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Constructs a RetinaNet model using a MobileNet backbone with specified parameters.

methods.name: download_imagenet
methods.description: Downloads pre-trained ImageNet weights for the specified MobileNet backbone configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the backbone string is among the allowed options.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Preprocesses an input image for the network.
